in_marathi.name: Nadu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nadu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Sanskrit, Nadu means 'river'. It is derived from the Sanskrit root 'Nad', which means 'to flow'. In Hindu mythology, rivers are considered sacred and are often personified as goddesses. Therefore, the name Nadu is believed to symbolize the flowing nature of life, as well as the nourishing and cleansing power of water.
